scope: Authenticated read-only localhost wallet reader against the existing remote Accounts session service and configured remote PostgreSQL. Interactive observations, not controlled production p95 or browser LCP.
notes: Normal workspace uses one financial SELECT inside BEGIN/COMMIT; the separate local identity lookup adds a fourth query. An overlapping verified identity request may share that lookup, resulting in three queries attributed to this request.
Authentication time contains the local identity DB lookup, so auth time and query_total_ms overlap and must not be summed.
No financial data, user identifiers, credentials or SQL parameters are included.
